Captain Zain leads the team with over 18 years of experience in luxury yachting, ensuring safe and smooth operations. title: MAYAS
overview:
The MAYAS 75FT yacht embodies luxury and sophistication, making it an ideal choice for larger groups
                seeking a memorable
                experience on the water. With its elegant design and spacious deck, the yacht offers ample room for
                sunbathing, socializing,
                and enjoying stunning views. Inside, guests will find beautifully appointed cabins that provide comfort
                and privacy for overnight
                stays. The powerful twin engines ensure a smooth and exhilarating ride, whether you’re cruising along
                the coastline or exploring
                nearby islands. The MAYAS is perfect for hosting events, family gatherings, or a relaxing day at sea.
                Experience unparalleled
                comfort and style aboard this magnificent yacht.

extraSections.title: CREW
extraSections.content: The MAYAS is operated by a skilled and dedicated crew committed to providing an exceptional experience for every guest. Captain Rami, with over 12 years of experience in luxury yachting, leads the crew with expertise and professionalism. He is supported by First Mate Leila and Stewardess Yasmin, who ensure that all guest needs are met with the highest level of service, creating a welcoming and enjoyable atmosphere on board.

title: Medusa - 100 Ft
specs: Guest Capacity: 25 guests (day cruising), 10 guests (overnight stays)
Dining: Oval dining table for 10 guests on the main deck aft
Flybridge: Full-beam sunbed, spa pool, helm controls
overview:
The Azimut 100 ft Yacht offers a luxurious and spacious experience for 25 guests. Whether you’re
                cruising or staying overnight, the yacht’s elegant design and premium accommodations make it an ideal
                choice. The primary suite and VIP stateroom offer plenty of space for relaxation, while two twin cabins
                are perfect for smaller groups. A professional crew ensures top-tier service, while the outdoor spaces,
                including the flybridge with sunbeds and spa pool, provide the perfect setting for relaxation and water
                activities.
              


              
                The yacht is equipped with an oval dining table that seats up to 10 guests, making it perfect for dining
                with a view. Whether you're cruising along the coastline or hosting a luxurious evening, the Azimut 100
                ft Yacht provides an unparalleled experience.

title: OCEANDREAM
overview:
The OCEANDREAM 141FT yacht offers an unparalleled level of luxury and sophistication, designed to host
                large gatherings
                and events. Its striking design and spacious layout create a perfect setting for celebrations, corporate
                events, or
                leisurely outings on the water. The expansive deck provides stunning views and ample space for
                sunbathing, dining, and
                socializing. Inside, the yacht features elegant interiors that promise comfort and style, accommodating
                14-16 guests
                for overnight stays. With powerful quad engines, the OCEANDREAM ensures exhilarating speeds of 50 knots,
                allowing for
                quick access to beautiful coastal destinations. This yacht redefines luxury on the water, promising an
                unforgettable
                experience for every guest on board.

extraSections.title: CREW
extraSections.content: The OCEANDREAM is operated by a highly skilled and attentive crew dedicated to providing exceptional service. Captain Amir leads the team with over 20 years of experience in luxury yachting, ensuring a safe and enjoyable journey. He is supported by First Mate Sara and Stewardess Hana, who work diligently to cater to every guest's needs and create a welcoming atmosphere on board, ensuring that all experiences are memorable and enjoyable.

title: Pershing 70
overview:
The **Pershing 70** stands out with its cutting-edge design, featuring dynamic side wings and a sleek
                "Champagner Pearl" hull. Designed by Fulvio De Simoni, this 70-foot motor yacht is a symbol of speed and
                luxury, powered by two MTU 10V 2000 M96L engines capable of reaching top speeds of 46 knots.
              


              
                The main deck seamlessly integrates the salon and cockpit areas, offering a spacious entertainment zone.
                Below deck, the yacht features three luxurious cabins, including a full-beam owner's suite, with an
                optional two-cabin version providing more lounge space. This yacht perfectly combines performance,
                design, and comfort for an unforgettable cruising experience.

title: Pershing 8X
overview:
The Pershing 8X combines luxury, speed, and performance with its aggressive, sleek exterior and top
                speed of 45 knots. The yacht offers a thrilling yet elegant cruising experience, ideal for Dubai
                charters. It features expansive indoor and outdoor spaces, including a retractable helm on the
                flybridge, sun pads, alfresco dining areas, and a hydraulic swim platform for easy water access.
              


              
                Inside, the yacht has a contemporary design with a comfortable lounge, dining space, and entertainment
                systems for the ultimate relaxation. Accommodating up to 8 guests in 4 ensuite staterooms, the Pershing
                8X offers the perfect combination of comfort and high-performance cruising.

title: PRINCESS
overview:
The PRINCESS 60FT yacht offers a perfect balance of elegance and power, ensuring an exceptional
                experience on the water. With expansive outdoor spaces and a stylish, modern interior, this yacht is
                ideal for socializing or relaxing in comfort. Its spacious cabins are perfect for overnight guests,
                while the deck provides plenty of space for day-trippers to enjoy the sun and sea. The powerful twin
                engines ensure a smooth ride and excellent maneuverability, making it suitable for coastal cruising or
                island-hopping. Whether it's a sunset cruise or a full-day charter, the PRINCESS 60FT delivers luxury
                and performance.

extraSections.title: CREW
extraSections.content: The PRINCESS 60FT is operated by an experienced and professional crew. Captain Faisal, with over 15 years of maritime experience, ensures the yacht's safe navigation. He is supported by Chief Officer Omar and Stewardess Ayesha, who look after the guests' comfort and provide top-notch service, ensuring a luxurious and enjoyable experience for all on board.

title: Saffuriya - 124 ft
specs: Hull Material: Fiberglass or Composite materials
overview:
The Peri Yachts Saffuriya offers an unparalleled luxury experience, combining modern design and high-end
                craftsmanship. With spacious cabins, a jacuzzi, a gym, and a cinema room, this yacht ensures ultimate
                relaxation and entertainment. The experienced crew, including a captain, chef, and stewardesses,
                provides first-class service, while gourmet meals are prepared with fresh, local ingredients. Perfect
                for Mediterranean cruises, this yacht offers customizable excursions to meet every need, whether for
                family gatherings or intimate getaways.

title: Santorini Superyacht 115
specs: Generator: Dual onboard generators for uninterrupted power
overview:
The Santorini Superyacht 115 offers a world of sophistication and luxury on the seas. This 115-foot
                marvel
                is designed for unforgettable experiences, hosting up to 50 guests for day charters and accommodating
                12 guests overnight in its 5 luxurious cabins. Each cabin is fitted with an en-suite bathroom, ensuring
                privacy and comfort.
                The yacht’s main salon boasts a dining area and bar, while the spacious Flybridge offers additional
                dining, a bar, and sunbeds.
                Complete with a jacuzzi and various water sports like jet skiing, the Santorini Superyacht provides
                relaxation
                and adventure in equal measure. Ideal for exclusive events or leisurely escapes, it delivers elegance
                and
                enjoyment for every guest.

extraSections.title: CREW
extraSections.content: The crew of the Santorini Superyacht 115 is led by Captain Elias Petrova, a seasoned sailor with over 20 years of experience navigating luxury yachts worldwide. Supporting him is First Mate Alexei Romanov, skilled in maritime operations and guest services. Engineer Marco Lang is responsible for all technical and mechanical aspects on board, ensuring smooth operation throughout the journey. Guests enjoy exquisite meals crafted by Chef Sophia Martinez, a culinary expert in Mediterranean and international cuisine. Chief Stewardess Lina Dubois oversees hospitality, ensuring every detail is perfect, with Steward Samir Khaled assisting to provide top-tier service. Deckhand Ethan Kim manages exterior maintenance and prepares water sports activities, creating a seamless and luxurious yachting experience for all on board.

title: SASMI
overview:
The SASMI 75FT yacht is a magnificent vessel designed for those who seek luxury and adventure on the
                water. With its spacious deck
                and elegant interiors, it offers an ideal setting for social gatherings, special events, or simply
                relaxing with friends and family.
                The yacht features state-of-the-art amenities and stylish cabins, ensuring comfort for all guests.
                Equipped with powerful twin engines,
                the SASMI provides a thrilling cruising experience, making it perfect for exploring coastal waters or
                enjoying scenic vistas. Whether
                for a day of fun or an overnight retreat, the SASMI delivers a unique and unforgettable maritime
                experience.

extraSections.title: CREW
extraSections.content: The SASMI is crewed by a professional and attentive team dedicated to providing an exceptional experience for all guests. Captain Amir leads the crew with over 10 years of experience in the yachting industry, ensuring safety and enjoyment during your voyage. He is assisted by First Mate Noor and Stewardess Lena, who work diligently to cater to guest needs and create a welcoming atmosphere on board.

title: Sunseeker 131
overview:
The Sunseeker 131 Yacht is a luxury tri-deck yacht designed to offer exceptional comfort and style on
                the water. Accommodating up to 12 guests, it features a spacious main deck lounge, a separate dining
                area, and a full galley for culinary excellence. The upper deck boasts a sky lounge, cocktail bar, and
                access to the Skydeck, perfect for enjoying breathtaking views. Built with high-quality materials, the
                yacht is ideal for both open-water adventures and elegant marina appearances, making it the epitome of
                contemporary superyacht luxury.

title: Sunseeker 95
overview:
The Sunseeker 95 offers unparalleled luxury and comfort on the water. With a sleek, open-plan interior
                and expansive exterior spaces, the yacht is perfect for relaxation and entertainment. It features a
                flybridge with al-fresco dining and a beach club for leisure, while the sophisticated design and
                luxurious master suite ensure a premium experience. Accommodating up to 12 PAX, this yacht is ideal for
                extended cruising with a range of 1,400 nautical miles at 12 knots.
